knowledge_nature.name: Knowledge (Nature)
knowledge_nature.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Survival gives +2 on Knowledge (nature) checks. 5+ ranks in Knowledge (nature) gives +2 on Survival checks in aboveground environments. Identifies Animals, Fey, Giants, Monstrous Humanoids, Plants, and Vermin.

actions.name: Identify Animal, Fey, Giant, Plant, or Vermin
actions.description: Recall natural habits, venom potency, seasonal migrations, and defense traits (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Predict Weather and Environmental Shifts
actions.description: Forecast sudden blizzards, flash floods, seasonal temperature drops, or poisonous spore seasons.
